description: Tasks Viewer – Kanban Chart PRO is the advanced version of our popular Power BI custom visual, built for professionals and teams that need complete flexibility and scalability when managing tasks in a kanban-style layout. Developed by Softcial, this powerful tool allows you to visualize an unlimited number of buckets and tasks, giving you full control over how your workflow data is displayed and interpreted in Power BI. It’s perfect for detailed project management, operational tracking, and process monitoring in dynamic business environments. With enhanced customization options — including custom bucket order, color schemes (hexadecimal or gradient), and advanced formatting — Softcial Kanban Tasks Viewer Pro helps you turn raw data into meaningful, visual task management boards that adapt to your business needs. Key Features Unlimited buckets – Visualize as many workflow categories as needed — no limits. Unlimited tasks per bucket – Easily display large volumes of tasks in each bucket, with smooth vertical scrolling. Custom bucket order – Arrange your buckets in any sequence that fits your process or reporting logic. Custom bucket colors – Define colors using exact hexadecimal codes or apply a color gradient for better visual hierarchy. Color logic from data source – Choose between gradient-based styling or use color values directly from your data model for dynamic formatting.…
